issuer: the municipality's Borgerservice, with the driving tests held by the Danish Road Traffic Authority (Færdselsstyrelsen)
note: Read 2026-10-30. borger.dk gives category B from 17 or 18 (at 17 only in accompanied driving until 18, not held), so a full licence is kept from 18; its renewal page says licences for cars issued after 19 January 2013 are valid for 15 years as a rule. The fee order (Bekendtgørelse om gebyrer og afgifter på Færdselsstyrelsens område, BEK nr 1596 af 11/12/2025, on retsinformation.dk) sets the driving test at 1,400 kr. (§ 15; with the Road Traffic Act's 200 kr. surcharge, 1,600 kr. on Færdselsstyrelsen's price list), and under 'Gebyr for udstedelse af kørekort' fees only for duplicates and reissues after a disqualification or surrender (§§ 21-26), with renewal at 270 kr. (§ 29); it sets no fee for issuing a first licence, and Færdselsstyrelsen's price list names none either. The test's fee isn't the licence's, and a missing line isn't read as a zero, so the fee is null. The theory test, the driving school and the medical certificate aren't held. The municipal identity card (legitimationskort) is the ids engine's, not held here. The exchange list (group 1 and group 2 countries) wasn't read.
